matched.note: Same defect: setting policy.json's base_ref to the current branch name makes GitMergeBase(HEAD, ownBranch) resolve to HEAD, so baseName==branch and policyBase returns isBoundary=false; CheckPolicy then hits `if !isBoundary { return nil, nil }` and every gated/strict diagnostic is skipped. Identical mechanism and file/function to golden GV3-002 (base_ref=branch -> isBoundary false -> CheckPolicy returns nil before diffs). Golden GV3-001 (free-mode short-circuit taken when the working copy's own policy.Mode is free and the base fails to resolve) and GV4-202 (base_ref literally "HEAD", which keeps isBoundary true but makes the base commit equal HEAD so surfaceDelta/ruleDelta diff against themselves and are vacuously empty) are distinct root causes the candidate does not describe, so they remain missed rather than double-counted here.

Same defect as GV3-166: cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh's post-invocation context-read deny only recognizes Read (raw, non-canonical file_path) and an exact two-token `cat <path>` Bash command; a multi-file cat, head/tail/sed/less, or any tool other than Read/Bash (e.g. Grep) is invisible to the tokenizer/case match and reads the governed context files unimpeded, defeating the gate's own stated enforcement guarantee.

Same defect: GitChangedFiles (internal/acdsl/git.go) splits git diff/untracked output on whitespace via strings.Fields, fragmenting any path containing a space into two bogus path tokens, so a rule declared or edited in such a file is invisible to ruleDelta and the gated/strict policy check.
